rows.subtopic: Facing a natural disaster at home
rows.subtype: Approach: preparing a go-bag in advance [Action]
rows.description: A person living in a flood-prone area keeps a bag with copies of documents, medicines, cash, torch and charger, so that leaving takes minutes without deciding under stress.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, resource and budget planning, sleeping on it

rows.subtopic: Facing a natural disaster at home
rows.subtype: Approach: contingency plan for a small business [Thinking]
rows.description: A shop owner considers what would happen if the shop floods for two weeks: moving stock to upper shelves, backing up bills online and agreeing on temporary sales through phone orders.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, resource and budget planning, sleeping on it

rows.subtopic: Facing a natural disaster at home
rows.subtype: Approach: relying on one contact for everything [Pitfall]
rows.description: The family assumes one relative will coordinate everything. When that relative's phone is out of network, nobody knows where to gather and precious hours are lost.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, resource and budget planning, sleeping on it

rows.subtopic: Facing a natural disaster at home
rows.description: Neighbours form a group to share boats, boiled water and elder care, and coordinate with the ward office, showing how shared effort covers what one household cannot.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, resource and budget planning, sleeping on it

rows.subtopic: Facing a natural disaster at home
rows.description: After the disaster, the person repairs essentials first, then postpones cosmetic work, and adjusts the budget as claims arrive, adapting to money as it becomes known.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, sleeping on it

rows.subtopic: Facing a natural disaster at home
rows.subtype: Approach: learning from the event to prepare better [Revision]
rows.description: Later, the family lists what went wrong: no shared meeting point, expired torch batteries. They fix each item and hold a yearly ten-minute drill.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, contingency planning, resource and budget planning, sleeping on it

rows.subtopic: Handling a legal or tax notice
rows.subtype: Approach: reading the notice carefully and noting the deadline [Thinking]
rows.description: On receiving a tax department email, the person reads who sent it, what is asked and the last date to respond, and does not react until the facts are clear.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, impulsive action

rows.subtopic: Handling a legal or tax notice
rows.subtype: Approach: verifying authenticity through official channels [Action]
rows.description: Aware of frauds using fake notices, the person logs in to the official portal directly and checks whether the same notice appears there, rather than clicking email links.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, commitment device, impulsive action

rows.subtopic: Handling a legal or tax notice
rows.subtype: Approach: ignoring the notice from fear [Pitfall]
rows.description: The person puts the letter in a drawer, hoping it is a mistake. The deadline passes, penalties are added, and a simple mismatch becomes a bigger problem.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, impulsive action

rows.subtopic: Handling a legal or tax notice
rows.subtype: Approach: gathering documents and reconciling numbers [Action]
rows.description: The person collects salary slips, Form 16, and bank statements, compares them line by line with the notice, and finds that one income entry was reported twice.
graph_context: same problem, other approaches: avoidance and procrastination, commitment device, impulsive action
